Hero.title: 50 Years SupporterFC Meilen
Hero.subtitle: A community of passion and tradition since 1975.

Intro.headline: Through victories and defeats, our community stood together on the terraces.
Intro.p1: Founded by a handful of devoted fans sharing a profound love for the game and their hometown, SupporterFC Meilen has grown into a cornerstone of local football culture. What began over a few beers post-match has evolved into a half-century legacy.
Intro.p2: From coordinating our first away-day trips in the late 70s to organizing massive choreographies in the modern era, our spirit remains unchanged: unconditional support.

HistoryPage.title: 50 Years of History
HistoryPage.subtitle: A half-century of passion, loyalty, and local tradition.
HistoryPage.foundationDesc: In the 70s, it all began with a group of friends who wanted to be more than just spectators. They wanted to be the soul of the club.
HistoryPage.milestone1Desc: From promotion to relegation, we stayed. Our colors fly proudly in every stadium.
HistoryPage.milestone2Desc: The introduction of our first major choreographies marked a turning point in Swiss fan culture.
HistoryPage.milestone3Desc: Today we celebrate not just a club, but a family that has existed since 1975.
